name: wordpress-cached-dynamic-form-to-crm
description: A consented Google Ads first touch survives a cached WordPress-shaped page, gains an email last touch, reaches a late-added form, and is exported unchanged to a CRM-controlled endpoint.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT: consent gates storage and delivery; first touch is write-once; a valid later campaign updates last touch; form and HTTP destinations expose the same canonical attribution fields.
